processing.description: Read the ADM0, ADM1 and NDLSA layers of the World Bank's GAD V1 shapefile as written (WGS 84 longitude and latitude, checked against the .prj; UTF-8 attributes, checked against the .cpg). Clockwise rings are outer rings and counter-clockwise rings holes, each hole in the smallest outer ring containing it. Holes inside no outer ring, turned clockwise and drawn as outer rings: ADM0 33, ADM1 33, NDLSA 0. Rings with no area (their points on one line), left out: ADM0 5, ADM1 6, NDLSA 0. Records with no rings, so no shape: ADM0 records 188, 189; ADM1 records 2275, 2866, 2867.

Countries: every ADM0 record is joined to the site's entity of its ISO_A3 code (Kosovo's KSV is KOS); the records of one entity form one multipolygon, nothing merged. Disputed areas (NDLSA) keep the World Bank's names, leading and trailing spaces removed, and carry no value.

CCKP's regions were matched to ADM1 records country by country: 2,315 by the GAUL rule ({ISO_A3}.{GAUL_0}{GAUL_1}), 470 by the ADM1CD rule ({ISO_A3}.{GAUL_0}{int(ADM1CD_t[3:])}), each only where the names agree; 80 by pairs declared in pipeline/geo/cckp-adm1-declared.csv; 311 by a name unique on both sides, only in countries with as many CCKP regions as records. 319 CCKP regions are listed without a shape, 1 matched to a record with no shape (MLT.1561954), and 422 records are drawn without a value. CCKP's 32 DIS.* units are left out, and so are the 3 units it lists under China for Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, places with regions of their own (as in pipeline/geo/entities.csv). The name rule was withheld, the counts differing, in: AZE, BDI, CAF, CPV, CUB, DJI, ESP, EST, ETH, FJI, GHA, GMB, GNB, IDN, JAM, KHM, MDA, MDG, MLI, MOZ, MRT, NZL, ROU, SEN, SYC, UMI, USA, ZAF, ZWE.

Simplified with the topojson library (topology with shared borders, Douglas-Peucker on arcs, rings kept at least a triangle). World: coordinates snapped to 100,000 steps, epsilon 0.25°, polygons and holes under 0.05 square degrees left out, output quantised to 10,000 steps. Each country: the same with epsilon its extent / 1500, minimum area (its extent / 300)², and 4,000 steps across its extent. Each feature's rp is a representative point of its full, unsimplified shape (4 decimals); a feature with nothing left at its scale is a null geometry with that point. After simplifying, every outer ring is wound clockwise and every hole counter-clockwise, as d3-geo reads them on the sphere: a ring the library wound backwards (an enclave's ring shared whole with its neighbour's hole, or a small island folded onto itself) is referenced the other way round, changing no border, and a ring left with no area is left out. A country's file holds the disputed areas within 0.01° of its shapes.
